preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 200 inclusive.
For each test case, the array size N is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The integer k is non-negative and at most 10^18.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**18 for x in A)
preconditions.description: All elements in array A are non-negative integers at most 10^18.
The array A contains exactly N integers.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer.

postconditions.expression: all(count_pairs(A_t, k_t) == int(stdout_lines[t]) for t, (A_t, k_t) in enumerate(zip(all_arrays, all_ks)))
postconditions.description: For each test case t, the output integer equals the count of pairs (i, j) with 1 <= i < j <= N such that (A[i-1] | A[j-1]) + (A[i-1] ^ A[j-1]) + (A[i-1] & A[j-1]) == k + A[j-1].
